response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.riskeval AS status, SUM(sc.gbsize) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY s.riskeval), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM g WHERE rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(g.rate - b.bench) AS avg_margin_above_benchmark FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.rate > b.bench
